svg.text: Container diagram for Tribunal - 2b. After a ruling: operations, learning loop, publishing
C4 level 2, part 2 of 2. Nothing here edits an existing brief or prompt; an amendment takes effect only at a new policy version a named person approves.
AI work assistant; starts the connector
draft: one clause for a flagged cluster
approve / reject: a named person only.
rerun: the pipeline at the new version;
Every case's ruling or ESCALATE, brief
[Container: Python CLI, ops/ - no model call]
Written for version 6; reads version-8 runs
review; kill switch; version 6: above SGD 8.00
Static HTML from data/, policy/ and runs/.
reads the policy via ui/v2 readers.
reads runs; rerun writes new ones

Checked against the code at freeze-2026-10-14-v8 (af2b5ca); version 6's amendments are policy/v3/amendments/*.json (docs/notes/2026-10-10-ns-12-confirmed-by-policy-owner.md); version 8 is Ryde's v2.1 with Ryde's answers of 2026-10-14 (docs/notes/2026-10-14-policy-v8.md).
